title: Read useful word endings
goal: Use a taught spelling pattern to attempt a word, check its pronunciation and connect it with meaning.
cue: Blend the base word, then add its ending: cats /s/, dogs /z/, buses /ɪz/. The ending can change meaning, and only some forms add a syllable.
spelling: The pronunciation of -s or -es depends on the last sound of the base word, not simply the last letter.
task: Read cat then cats. Read bus then buses. Count the spoken syllables and explain the change in meaning.
story: Two cats sit by the bus stop. The buses pass them.

articulation.label: cats
articulation.alt: cats: /k/ → /æ/ → /t/ → /s/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /k/: Back of tongue meets the soft palate; release.
/æ/: Low front tongue; open the jaw.
/t/: Tongue tip touches the ridge, then releases.
/s/: Make a narrow gap near the ridge; let air flow.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.

articulation.label: dogs
articulation.alt: dogs: /d/ → /ɔ/ → /ɡ/ → /z/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /d/: Tip touches the ridge; add voice and release.
/ɔ/: Back tongue; lips rounded.
/ɡ/: Back of tongue meets the soft palate; add voice.
/z/: A narrow gap near the ridge; add voice.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.

articulation.label: buses
articulation.alt: buses: /b/ → /ʌ/ → /s/ → /ɪ/ → /z/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /b/: Close lips briefly; release into the next vowel.
/ʌ/: Tongue central; jaw comfortably open.
/s/: Make a narrow gap near the ridge; let air flow.
/ɪ/: Front tongue, a little lower and relaxed.
/z/: A narrow gap near the ridge; add voice.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.

articulation.label: cups
articulation.alt: cups: /k/ → /ʌ/ → /p/ → /s/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /k/: Back of tongue meets the soft palate; release.
/ʌ/: Tongue central; jaw comfortably open.
/p/: Close the lips, then release the air.
/s/: Make a narrow gap near the ridge; let air flow.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.
